#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

class FastReader {
private:
    istringstream iss;
    string line;
public:
    FastReader() {
        // Will read first line when needed
    }

    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (iss >> line) {
                return line;
            }
            if (!getline(cin, line)) {
                break;
            }
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        return "";
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
};

class FastWriter {
public:
    void println(long long x) {
        cout << x << "\n";
    }

    void println(int x) {
        cout << x << "\n";
    }

    void flush() {
        cout.flush();
    }
};

FastReader in;
FastWriter out;

class Modulo {
private:
    long long mod;

public:
    Modulo(long long mod) : mod(mod) {}

    long long plus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }

    long long minus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }

    long long times(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a % mod) * (b % mod) % mod;
    }

    long long div(long long a, long long b) {
        return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }

    long long pow(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = 1;
        a %= mod;
        while (b > 0) {
            if (b & 1) {
                c = c * a % mod;
            }
            a = a * a % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    long long combination(int n, int k, const vector<long long>& factorials) {
        return div(factorials[n], times(factorials[k], factorials[n - k]));
    }

    vector<long long> factorials(int n) {
        vector<long long> f(n + 1);
        f[0] = 1LL;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }
};

void solve() {
    int n = in.nextInt();
    long long kt = in.nextLong();

    if (kt >= n) {
        out.println(0);
        return;
    }

    int k = (int) kt;
    Modulo mod(998244353);
    vector<long long> facts = mod.factorials(n);

    long long ans = 0;
    int c = n - k;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
        long long t = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, facts), mod.pow(c - i, n));
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = mod.plus(ans, t);
        } else {
            ans = mod.minus(ans, t);
        }
    }
    ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));

    if (k > 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
    out.println(ans);
}

int main() {
    int t = 1;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        solve();
    }
    out.flush();
    return 0;
}
